description: This Java class implements calculations related to payment periods within a year and interest calculation fractions for loan scheduling in Apache Fineract.

classes.name: DefaultPaymentPeriodsInOneYearCalculator
classes.description: Implements the calculation of payment periods per year based on different repayment frequency types and computes interest charging period fractions for loan repayment scheduling.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Determines the number of payment periods in one year for a given repayment frequency type.

methods.name: calculatePortionOfRepaymentPeriodInterestChargingGrace
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of interest to be charged during a repayment period considering a grace period start date.

methods.name: calculateRepaymentPeriodFraction
methods.description: Auxiliary method to compute the fraction of a repayment period based on the frequency type and number of days for interest calculation grace.
